MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations,
2015, we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors in their meeting held today i.e., 14th November,
2026, at the Registered Office of the Company situated at 403, Mayfair Corporate Park, Behind DPS
School, Kalali, Vadodara, Gujarat, India, 390012 which commenced at 04:00 P.M. and concluded at 05:30
P.M. inter-alia has considered and approved:
1. The Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the Half Year ended on 30th September, 2026
along with Limited Review Report.
2. Statement of Deviations/ Variations for the proceeds of the Initial Public Offering ("IPO") for the Half
Year ended on 30th September, 2026 as per Regulation 32 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure
Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
3. Appointment of Mr. Kiransih Mansinh Parmar as a Chief Financial Officer of the Company w.e.f 14th
November, 2026.
